paragraphs.en: We moved a copy of 99.99999% of GitHub’s repositories to Azure. Here’s how per-reference quorums will bring over the rest, and how object storage lets reads scale independently.
paragraphs.zh: 我们已将 GitHub 99.99999% 的仓库副本迁移到 Azure。 下面介绍按引用法定数（per-reference quorums）将如何迁移其余部分，以及对象存储如何让读取独立扩展。

sents.en: We moved a copy of 99.99999% of GitHub’s repositories to Azure.
sents.zh: 我们已将 GitHub 99.99999% 的仓库副本迁移到 Azure。

sents.en: Here’s how per-reference quorums will bring over the rest, and how object storage lets reads scale independently.
sents.zh: 下面介绍按引用法定数（per-reference quorums）将如何迁移其余部分，以及对象存储如何让读取独立扩展。

paragraphs.en: Over the past year, while Git traffic grew exponentially, 99.99999% of the Git repositories on GitHub began living in two places at once: our own data centers and Azure. The rest are among the busiest on the platform, and they’re held back by just one thing: a 25ms round trip.
paragraphs.zh: 在过去一年里，尽管 Git 流量呈指数级增长，GitHub 上 99.99999% 的 Git 仓库开始同时存在于两个地方：我们自己的数据中心和 Azure。 其余的那些仓库属于平台上最繁忙的一批，而制约它们的只有一件事：25 毫秒的往返延迟。

sents.en: Over the past year, while Git traffic grew exponentially, 99.99999% of the Git repositories on GitHub began living in two places at once: our own data centers and Azure.
sents.zh: 在过去一年里，尽管 Git 流量呈指数级增长，GitHub 上 99.99999% 的 Git 仓库开始同时存在于两个地方：我们自己的数据中心和 Azure。

sents.en: The rest are among the busiest on the platform, and they’re held back by just one thing: a 25ms round trip.
sents.zh: 其余的那些仓库属于平台上最繁忙的一批，而制约它们的只有一件事：25 毫秒的往返延迟。

paragraphs.en: In an earlier blog post , we laid out the two principles behind our next-generation storage architecture:
paragraphs.zh: 在之前的一篇博客文章中，我们阐述了下一代存储架构背后的两大原则：

paragraphs.en: In this post, we’ll look at the immediate bridge between our old design and our new one. We’ll talk about how a change to the way our quorum serializes writes gets the busiest repositories into Azure, and how that same step opens the door to replicas that keep no persistent state of their own.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们将探讨旧设计与新设计之间的直接过渡桥梁。 我们将讨论如何通过更改法定人数串行化写入的方式，把最繁忙的仓库迁移到 Azure，以及这一步骤如何为不保留自身持久状态的副本打开了大门。

sents.en: In this post, we’ll look at the immediate bridge between our old design and our new one.
sents.zh: 在本文中，我们将探讨旧设计与新设计之间的直接过渡桥梁。

sents.en: We’ll talk about how a change to the way our quorum serializes writes gets the busiest repositories into Azure, and how that same step opens the door to replicas that keep no persistent state of their own.
sents.zh: 我们将讨论如何通过更改法定人数串行化写入的方式，把最繁忙的仓库迁移到 Azure，以及这一步骤如何为不保留自身持久状态的副本打开了大门。

paragraphs.en: The timing and shape of the move were driven by the agentic shift: rapidly growing traffic, a hard ceiling on the power capacity of our data centers and the surrounding geographical region, and physical supply chain constraints. At the beginning of our migration, the remaining capacity with all possible expansion gave us enough time to migrate safely, but not enough to do it slowly.
paragraphs.zh: 此次迁移的时机和形式是由智能体化转型所驱动的：流量快速增长、我们数据中心及周边地理区域的电力容量存在硬性上限，以及物理供应链的限制。 在迁移开始时，所有可能的扩容之后的剩余容量给了我们足够的时间来安全地完成迁移，但不允许我们慢慢来。

sents.en: The timing and shape of the move were driven by the agentic shift: rapidly growing traffic, a hard ceiling on the power capacity of our data centers and the surrounding geographical region, and physical supply chain constraints.
sents.zh: 此次迁移的时机和形式是由智能体化转型所驱动的：流量快速增长、我们数据中心及周边地理区域的电力容量存在硬性上限，以及物理供应链的限制。

sents.en: At the beginning of our migration, the remaining capacity with all possible expansion gave us enough time to migrate safely, but not enough to do it slowly.
sents.zh: 在迁移开始时，所有可能的扩容之后的剩余容量给了我们足够的时间来安全地完成迁移，但不允许我们慢慢来。

paragraphs.en: While we had prototyped new architectural approaches for scaling Git on cloud infrastructure, changing the storage architecture and the hosting platform at the same time, under that growth, carried too much risk. Given our scale and how critical the service is to the community, we needed to sequence the work carefully: move the data first, then evolve the architecture once it arrived.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然我们已经为在云基础设施上扩展 Git 搭建了新架构方法的雏形，但在那种增长速度下，同时改变存储架构和托管平台的风险太大了。 鉴于我们的规模以及该服务对社区的关键性，我们需要谨慎安排工作顺序：先迁移数据，等数据到位后再演进架构。

sents.en: While we had prototyped new architectural approaches for scaling Git on cloud infrastructure, changing the storage architecture and the hosting platform at the same time, under that growth, carried too much risk.
sents.zh: 虽然我们已经为在云基础设施上扩展 Git 搭建了新架构方法的雏形，但在那种增长速度下，同时改变存储架构和托管平台的风险太大了。

sents.en: Given our scale and how critical the service is to the community, we needed to sequence the work carefully: move the data first, then evolve the architecture once it arrived.
sents.zh: 鉴于我们的规模以及该服务对社区的关键性，我们需要谨慎安排工作顺序：先迁移数据，等数据到位后再演进架构。

paragraphs.en: Git operations are a Tier 0 service: they’re a core function of GitHub, and nearly everything in GitHub depends on the repository data. That meant the data, services, and every dependency had to move first. The first copy of a repository landed in Azure’s Central US region in August 2025. Today, most repositories have two of their five replicas in Azure, and Azure serves about half of Git traffic. For most of that time, Azure absorbed our growth while our own data centers held steady.
paragraphs.zh: Git 操作是一项 Tier 0 服务：它是 GitHub 的核心功能，GitHub 中几乎所有的东西都依赖于仓库数据。 这意味着数据、服务以及所有依赖项都必须首先迁移。 第一份仓库副本于 2025 年 8 月落地到 Azure 的美国中部区域。 如今，大多数仓库的五个副本中有两个位于 Azure，Azure 承载了大约一半的 Git 流量。 在此期间的大部分时间里，Azure 吸收了我们的增长，而我们自己的数据中心则保持稳定。

sents.en: Git operations are a Tier 0 service: they’re a core function of GitHub, and nearly everything in GitHub depends on the repository data.
sents.zh: Git 操作是一项 Tier 0 服务：它是 GitHub 的核心功能，GitHub 中几乎所有的东西都依赖于仓库数据。

sents.en: That meant the data, services, and every dependency had to move first.
sents.zh: 这意味着数据、服务以及所有依赖项都必须首先迁移。

sents.en: The first copy of a repository landed in Azure’s Central US region in August 2025.
sents.zh: 第一份仓库副本于 2025 年 8 月落地到 Azure 的美国中部区域。

sents.en: Today, most repositories have two of their five replicas in Azure, and Azure serves about half of Git traffic.
sents.zh: 如今，大多数仓库的五个副本中有两个位于 Azure，Azure 承载了大约一半的 Git 流量。

sents.en: For most of that time, Azure absorbed our growth while our own data centers held steady.
sents.zh: 在此期间的大部分时间里，Azure 吸收了我们的增长，而我们自己的数据中心则保持稳定。

paragraphs.en: During the migration, traffic follows the data. Most repositories have five replicas to balance durability, availability, and scale. To minimize read latency, Spokes uses preferential routing to direct traffic to a replica in the same region and availability zone as the request. As replicas move to Azure, the share of the traffic that can be served from Azure grows with each one, until the last replica arrives and the old region stops receiving requests entirely. Every repository goes through this process:
paragraphs.zh: 在迁移过程中，流量跟随数据。 大多数仓库有五个副本，以平衡持久性、可用性和可扩展性。 为了尽量降低读取延迟，Spokes 采用优先路由，将流量引导至与请求处于相同区域和可用区的副本。 随着副本逐步迁移到 Azure，可由 Azure 服务的流量份额随之增长，直到最后一个副本到达，旧区域完全停止接收请求。 每个仓库都要经历这一流程：

sents.en: During the migration, traffic follows the data.
sents.zh: 在迁移过程中，流量跟随数据。

sents.en: Most repositories have five replicas to balance durability, availability, and scale.
sents.zh: 大多数仓库有五个副本，以平衡持久性、可用性和可扩展性。

sents.en: To minimize read latency, Spokes uses preferential routing to direct traffic to a replica in the same region and availability zone as the request.
sents.zh: 为了尽量降低读取延迟，Spokes 采用优先路由，将流量引导至与请求处于相同区域和可用区的副本。

sents.en: As replicas move to Azure, the share of the traffic that can be served from Azure grows with each one, until the last replica arrives and the old region stops receiving requests entirely.
sents.zh: 随着副本逐步迁移到 Azure，可由 Azure 服务的流量份额随之增长，直到最后一个副本到达，旧区域完全停止接收请求。

sents.zh: 每个仓库都要经历这一流程：

paragraphs.en: So, what about the remaining 0.00001% of repositories?
paragraphs.zh: 那么，剩下的 0.00001% 的仓库呢？

paragraphs.en: In our current architecture, a repository hosted in more than one region has a lower write throughput ceiling. Spokes’ quorum only needs a majority to commit a write, but it waits for every healthy replica to respond (up to a timeout) before moving on, so slow replicas delay every write rather than falling behind. In practice, that means the slowest healthy replica sets the latency of every write, and because each write holds a repository-wide lock until it commits, it also sets the throughput ceiling. Once a replica lives in the target Azure region, it’s about 1,000 miles from our data centers, making each network round trip around 25ms, and a write requires multiple round trips. A repository already near its throughput ceiling can’t absorb that on every serialized write; it would fall further behind with every push.
paragraphs.zh: 在我们当前的架构中，托管在多个区域的仓库具有更低的写入吞吐量上限。 辐射节点的法定人数只需要多数派即可提交写入，但它会等待每个健康副本响应（直到超时）才继续推进，因此缓慢的副本会延迟每一次写入，而不是落在后面。 在实践中，这意味着最慢的健康副本决定了每一次写入的延迟，并且由于每次写入在提交前都会持有仓库级别的锁，它也决定了吞吐量上限。 一旦副本位于目标 Azure 区域，它距离我们的数据中心大约 1,000 英里，使每次网络往返约为 25 毫秒，而一次写入需要多次往返。 已经接近其吞吐量上限的仓库无法在每次串行化的写入中吸收这种开销；否则每次推送都会让它进一步落后。

sents.en: In our current architecture, a repository hosted in more than one region has a lower write throughput ceiling.
sents.zh: 在我们当前的架构中，托管在多个区域的仓库具有更低的写入吞吐量上限。

sents.en: Spokes’ quorum only needs a majority to commit a write, but it waits for every healthy replica to respond (up to a timeout) before moving on, so slow replicas delay every write rather than falling behind.
sents.zh: 辐射节点的法定人数只需要多数派即可提交写入，但它会等待每个健康副本响应（直到超时）才继续推进，因此缓慢的副本会延迟每一次写入，而不是落在后面。

sents.zh: 在实践中，这意味着最慢的健康副本决定了每一次写入的延迟，并且由于每次写入在提交前都会持有仓库级别的锁，它也决定了吞吐量上限。

sents.en: Once a replica lives in the target Azure region, it’s about 1,000 miles from our data centers, making each network round trip around 25ms, and a write requires multiple round trips.
sents.zh: 一旦副本位于目标 Azure 区域，它距离我们的数据中心大约 1,000 英里，使每次网络往返约为 25 毫秒，而一次写入需要多次往返。

sents.en: A repository already near its throughput ceiling can’t absorb that on every serialized write; it would fall further behind with every push.
sents.zh: 已经接近其吞吐量上限的仓库无法在每次串行化的写入中吸收这种开销；否则每次推送都会让它进一步落后。

paragraphs.en: This is where our first principle, minimizing coordination, comes into play. Specifically for this case: don’t serialize what doesn’t need to be. Git’s consistency requirements apply to each reference individually. Once the server accepts an update to a reference, no client should see an older value afterward, only that value or a newer one. That holds whether the update is a fast-forward, a force push, or a delete. But in most cases, updates to different references don’t depend on each other and can be applied independently.
paragraphs.zh: 这正是我们的第一个原则——最小化协调——发挥作用的地方。 具体到这种情况：不需要串行化的内容就不要串行化。 Git 的一致性要求是针对每个引用单独适用的。 一旦服务器接受了对某个引用的更新，之后任何客户端都不应看到更旧的值，只能看到该值或更新的值。 无论该更新是快进合并、强制推送还是删除，这一点都成立。 但在大多数情况下，对不同引用的更新彼此并不依赖，可以独立地应用。

sents.en: This is where our first principle, minimizing coordination, comes into play.
sents.zh: 这正是我们的第一个原则——最小化协调——发挥作用的地方。

sents.en: Specifically for this case: don’t serialize what doesn’t need to be.
sents.zh: 具体到这种情况：不需要串行化的内容就不要串行化。

sents.en: Git’s consistency requirements apply to each reference individually.
sents.zh: Git 的一致性要求是针对每个引用单独适用的。

sents.en: Once the server accepts an update to a reference, no client should see an older value afterward, only that value or a newer one.
sents.zh: 一旦服务器接受了对某个引用的更新，之后任何客户端都不应看到更旧的值，只能看到该值或更新的值。

sents.en: That holds whether the update is a fast-forward, a force push, or a delete.
sents.zh: 无论该更新是快进合并、强制推送还是删除，这一点都成立。

sents.en: But in most cases, updates to different references don’t depend on each other and can be applied independently.
sents.zh: 但在大多数情况下，对不同引用的更新彼此并不依赖，可以独立地应用。

paragraphs.en: So, we’re changing the scope of the quorum from the whole repository to individual references.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，我们将法定人数（quorum）的范围从整个仓库改为单个引用。

paragraphs.en: Holding a repository-wide lock for the entire reference update, round trips included, turns the quorum into a single, unordered request queue with one write in flight at a time. Each write in that queue takes as long as the slowest healthy replica. As the write rate grows, so does the queue, and each write waits longer than the one before it.
paragraphs.zh: 在整个引用更新（包括往返耗时）期间持有仓库级锁，会使法定人数变成一个单一、无序的请求队列，同一时间只能有一个写入在进行。 队列中每次写入的耗时等于最慢的健康副本的耗时。 随着写入速率增长，队列也随之变长，每次写入的等待时间都比前一次更长。

sents.en: Holding a repository-wide lock for the entire reference update, round trips included, turns the quorum into a single, unordered request queue with one write in flight at a time.
sents.zh: 在整个引用更新（包括往返耗时）期间持有仓库级锁，会使法定人数变成一个单一、无序的请求队列，同一时间只能有一个写入在进行。

sents.en: Each write in that queue takes as long as the slowest healthy replica.
sents.zh: 队列中每次写入的耗时等于最慢的健康副本的耗时。

sents.en: As the write rate grows, so does the queue, and each write waits longer than the one before it.
sents.zh: 随着写入速率增长，队列也随之变长，每次写入的等待时间都比前一次更长。

paragraphs.en: With per-reference serialization, only writes that contend on a shared reference must wait for each other. In practice, most writes to a repository touch different references—for example, agents and developers pushing to their own branches—so they no longer wait on each other. Each write still experiences the cross-region latency but writes to different references can be in flight at the same time. That removes the single bottleneck on the repository. We can visualize how queueing and timeouts build up by comparing the two approaches side by side under similar load:
paragraphs.zh: 采用按引用串行化后，只有对同一共享引用存在竞争的写入才需要相互等待。 在实践中，对仓库的大多数写入操作都涉及不同的引用——例如智能体和开发者推送到各自的分支——因此它们不再需要相互等待。 每次写入仍然会经历跨区域延迟，但对不同引用的写入可以同时进行。 这消除了仓库上的单一瓶颈。 通过在类似负载下并排比较这两种方式，我们可以直观地看到排队和超时是如何逐步累积的：

sents.en: With per-reference serialization, only writes that contend on a shared reference must wait for each other.
sents.zh: 采用按引用串行化后，只有对同一共享引用存在竞争的写入才需要相互等待。

sents.en: In practice, most writes to a repository touch different references—for example, agents and developers pushing to their own branches—so they no longer wait on each other.
sents.zh: 在实践中，对仓库的大多数写入操作都涉及不同的引用——例如智能体和开发者推送到各自的分支——因此它们不再需要相互等待。

sents.en: Each write still experiences the cross-region latency but writes to different references can be in flight at the same time.
sents.zh: 每次写入仍然会经历跨区域延迟，但对不同引用的写入可以同时进行。

sents.en: That removes the single bottleneck on the repository.
sents.zh: 这消除了仓库上的单一瓶颈。

sents.en: We can visualize how queueing and timeouts build up by comparing the two approaches side by side under similar load:
sents.zh: 通过在类似负载下并排比较这两种方式，我们可以直观地看到排队和超时是如何逐步累积的：

paragraphs.en: These changes raise a repository’s write throughput ceiling roughly in proportion to how many references are being written at once, and get the last remaining repositories into Azure. In internal testing with realistic traffic, writes to different references consistently saw 3–4x higher throughput at lower latency.
paragraphs.zh: 这些改动大致按一次性写入的引用数量成比例地提高了仓库的写入吞吐量上限，并将最后剩余的仓库迁移到了 Azure。 在使用真实流量的内部测试中，对不同引用的写入始终获得了 3–4 倍的更高吞吐量，同时延迟更低。

sents.en: These changes raise a repository’s write throughput ceiling roughly in proportion to how many references are being written at once, and get the last remaining repositories into Azure.
sents.zh: 这些改动大致按一次性写入的引用数量成比例地提高了仓库的写入吞吐量上限，并将最后剩余的仓库迁移到了 Azure。

sents.en: In internal testing with realistic traffic, writes to different references consistently saw 3–4x higher throughput at lower latency.
sents.zh: 在使用真实流量的内部测试中，对不同引用的写入始终获得了 3–4 倍的更高吞吐量，同时延迟更低。

paragraphs.en: Most repositories are heavily read-skewed, with somewhere between 100 and 1,000 reads for every write. Today, reads and writes hit the same replicas, so they compete for the same resources and can’t be scaled independently.
paragraphs.zh: 大多数代码库的读写比例严重偏向读，每次写入大约对应 100 到 1,000 次读取。 目前，读和写访问相同的副本，因此它们竞争相同的资源，无法独立扩展。

sents.en: Most repositories are heavily read-skewed, with somewhere between 100 and 1,000 reads for every write.
sents.zh: 大多数代码库的读写比例严重偏向读，每次写入大约对应 100 到 1,000 次读取。

sents.en: Today, reads and writes hit the same replicas, so they compete for the same resources and can’t be scaled independently.
sents.zh: 目前，读和写访问相同的副本，因此它们竞争相同的资源，无法独立扩展。

paragraphs.en: Decoupling storage from compute changes that. Once repository data is durably stored in Azure Blob Storage and updated with each incoming write, we can begin to decouple read traffic from the write quorum, and independently scale the compute needed for each. For example, reads would benefit from far more in-memory cache than we give them today, but that memory is also needed for compaction. Once they’re separated, each gets its own configuration.
paragraphs.zh: 存储与计算解耦改变了这一点。 一旦仓库数据持久地存储在 Azure Blob 存储中并随每次传入写入进行更新，我们就可以开始将读取流量与写入仲裁解耦，并独立扩展各自所需的计算资源。 例如，读取操作可以从比今天多得多的内存缓存中受益，但这些内存同时也是压缩所需的。 一旦两者分离，各自就有了自己的配置。

sents.en: Decoupling storage from compute changes that.
sents.zh: 存储与计算解耦改变了这一点。

sents.en: Once repository data is durably stored in Azure Blob Storage and updated with each incoming write, we can begin to decouple read traffic from the write quorum, and independently scale the compute needed for each.
sents.zh: 一旦仓库数据持久地存储在 Azure Blob 存储中并随每次传入写入进行更新，我们就可以开始将读取流量与写入仲裁解耦，并独立扩展各自所需的计算资源。

sents.en: For example, reads would benefit from far more in-memory cache than we give them today, but that memory is also needed for compaction.
sents.zh: 例如，读取操作可以从比今天多得多的内存缓存中受益，但这些内存同时也是压缩所需的。

sents.en: Once they’re separated, each gets its own configuration.
sents.zh: 一旦两者分离，各自就有了自己的配置。

paragraphs.en: The first step is making object storage a member of the quorum, but a special one that we call a virtual replica. The compute that represents it is our first fully ephemeral node. It serves as a bridge to object storage, streaming incoming writes and serving no reads. Because it’s a member of the quorum, a write isn’t acknowledged until it’s durable in object storage.
paragraphs.zh: 第一步是让对象存储成为仲裁成员，但这是一个特殊的成员，我们称之为虚拟副本。 代表它的计算节点是我们的第一个完全临时的节点。 它充当通往对象存储的桥梁，流式传输传入的写入，而不提供任何读取。 因为它是仲裁成员之一，所以在写入持久化到对象存储之前，写入不会被确认。

sents.en: The first step is making object storage a member of the quorum, but a special one that we call a virtual replica.
sents.zh: 第一步是让对象存储成为仲裁成员，但这是一个特殊的成员，我们称之为虚拟副本。

sents.en: The compute that represents it is our first fully ephemeral node.
sents.zh: 代表它的计算节点是我们的第一个完全临时的节点。

sents.en: It serves as a bridge to object storage, streaming incoming writes and serving no reads.
sents.zh: 它充当通往对象存储的桥梁，流式传输传入的写入，而不提供任何读取。

sents.en: Because it’s a member of the quorum, a write isn’t acknowledged until it’s durable in object storage.
sents.zh: 因为它是仲裁成员之一，所以在写入持久化到对象存储之前，写入不会被确认。

paragraphs.en: That adds a little latency to each write, but just like the cross-region round trip, per-reference serialization keeps it from becoming a throughput bottleneck. The virtual write replica also coalesces transactions on disjoint references into a single set of network I/Os to object storage, so a busy repository pays for one round trip across many concurrent writes instead of one per write. For now, the virtual write replica also handles compaction, and read replicas inherit the compacted state.
paragraphs.zh: 这会为每次写入增加少量延迟，但正如跨区域往返一样，基于引用的序列化使它不会成为吞吐量瓶颈。 虚拟写副本还会将作用于不同引用的事务合并为对对象存储的一组网络 I/O，因此繁忙的仓库只需为多次并发写入支付一次往返开销，而不是每次写入一次往返。 目前，虚拟写副本还负责压缩，读副本则继承压缩后的状态。

sents.en: That adds a little latency to each write, but just like the cross-region round trip, per-reference serialization keeps it from becoming a throughput bottleneck.
sents.zh: 这会为每次写入增加少量延迟，但正如跨区域往返一样，基于引用的序列化使它不会成为吞吐量瓶颈。

sents.en: The virtual write replica also coalesces transactions on disjoint references into a single set of network I/Os to object storage, so a busy repository pays for one round trip across many concurrent writes instead of one per write.
sents.zh: 虚拟写副本还会将作用于不同引用的事务合并为对对象存储的一组网络 I/O，因此繁忙的仓库只需为多次并发写入支付一次往返开销，而不是每次写入一次往返。

sents.en: For now, the virtual write replica also handles compaction, and read replicas inherit the compacted state.
sents.zh: 目前，虚拟写副本还负责压缩，读副本则继承压缩后的状态。

paragraphs.en: With the virtual write replica in place, we can scale out as many virtual read replicas as a repository needs, on demand. Each read replica warms its cache from Azure Blob Storage and starts taking read traffic without joining the quorum, using object storage as the source of truth and reconciling its local state against it in the background.
paragraphs.zh: 有了虚拟写入副本之后，我们就可以按需为仓库扩展出任意数量的虚拟读取副本。 每个读取副本从 Azure Blob 存储预热其缓存，然后在不加入法定人数的情况下开始承接读取流量，它以对象存储作为事实来源，并在后台将其本地状态与之进行协调。

sents.en: With the virtual write replica in place, we can scale out as many virtual read replicas as a repository needs, on demand.
sents.zh: 有了虚拟写入副本之后，我们就可以按需为仓库扩展出任意数量的虚拟读取副本。

sents.en: Each read replica warms its cache from Azure Blob Storage and starts taking read traffic without joining the quorum, using object storage as the source of truth and reconciling its local state against it in the background.
sents.zh: 每个读取副本从 Azure Blob 存储预热其缓存，然后在不加入法定人数的情况下开始承接读取流量，它以对象存储作为事实来源，并在后台将其本地状态与之进行协调。

paragraphs.en: This step unlocks significant read scale. In internal testing, our distributed load testing harness routinely found ceilings in the current architecture. Against virtual read replicas, the harness hit its own limits first. It also comes with a few challenges that are solved in subsequent steps:
paragraphs.zh: 这一步解锁了可观的读取扩展能力。 在内部测试中，我们的分布式负载测试工具经常发现当前架构的性能上限。 面对虚拟读副本，测试工具先达到了自身的极限。 它还带来了一些挑战，这些挑战会在后续步骤中解决：

sents.en: This step unlocks significant read scale.
sents.zh: 这一步解锁了可观的读取扩展能力。

sents.en: In internal testing, our distributed load testing harness routinely found ceilings in the current architecture.
sents.zh: 在内部测试中，我们的分布式负载测试工具经常发现当前架构的性能上限。

sents.en: Against virtual read replicas, the harness hit its own limits first.
sents.zh: 面对虚拟读副本，测试工具先达到了自身的极限。

sents.en: It also comes with a few challenges that are solved in subsequent steps:
sents.zh: 它还带来了一些挑战，这些挑战会在后续步骤中解决：

paragraphs.en: How can we push write throughput further?
paragraphs.zh: 我们如何进一步提升写入吞吐量？

paragraphs.en: The GitHub of today was built on the Spokes quorum, and over the years Spokes has become much more than a quorum coordinator. It’s also an intelligent routing and load balancing layer, a unified API that internal clients use to access and transact repository data at well over 100 billion operations per day, and a collection of background systems we call “sweepers” that handle repository placement, repair, and rebalancing between storage nodes.
paragraphs.zh: 今天的 GitHub 构建在 Spokes 仲裁机制之上，而多年来，Spokes 已经远不止是一个仲裁协调器。 它还是一个智能路由和负载均衡层，是一个供内部客户端访问和处理仓库数据的统一 API，每天处理超过 1000 亿次操作；此外它还是一组我们称之为「清理器」（sweepers）的后台系统，负责处理仓库在存储节点之间的放置、修复和再均衡。

sents.en: The GitHub of today was built on the Spokes quorum, and over the years Spokes has become much more than a quorum coordinator.
sents.zh: 今天的 GitHub 构建在 Spokes 仲裁机制之上，而多年来，Spokes 已经远不止是一个仲裁协调器。

sents.en: It’s also an intelligent routing and load balancing layer, a unified API that internal clients use to access and transact repository data at well over 100 billion operations per day, and a collection of background systems we call “sweepers” that handle repository placement, repair, and rebalancing between storage nodes.
sents.zh: 它还是一个智能路由和负载均衡层，是一个供内部客户端访问和处理仓库数据的统一 API，每天处理超过 1000 亿次操作；此外它还是一组我们称之为「清理器」（sweepers）的后台系统，负责处理仓库在存储节点之间的放置、修复和再均衡。

paragraphs.en: The vast majority of what lives under the Spokes service umbrella applies just as well to the new architecture as it does to the existing one. But we also recognize that the commit protocol that has taken GitHub to a billion repositories won’t take it to the next billion and beyond.
paragraphs.zh: Spokes 服务体系下的绝大部分内容，既适用于现有架构，也同样适用于新架构。 但我们也认识到，让 GitHub 达到十亿仓库规模的提交协议，无法支撑它迈向下一个十亿乃至更远。

sents.en: The vast majority of what lives under the Spokes service umbrella applies just as well to the new architecture as it does to the existing one.
sents.zh: Spokes 服务体系下的绝大部分内容，既适用于现有架构，也同样适用于新架构。

sents.en: But we also recognize that the commit protocol that has taken GitHub to a billion repositories won’t take it to the next billion and beyond.
sents.zh: 但我们也认识到，让 GitHub 达到十亿仓库规模的提交协议，无法支撑它迈向下一个十亿乃至更远。

paragraphs.en: We’re not done yet. With these steps in place, the next limit is write throughput. Every write still waits on replicas that each hold a full copy of the repository, yet very little of a write actually needs to be ordered. Git objects are immutable and named by their contents, so they can be stored without anyone agreeing on them. What’s left is small, and the hard part is ordering it as fast as possible without moving the bottleneck somewhere else. Designing for that on a whiteboard is one thing. Doing it underneath a billion repositories that developers and agents are writing to around the clock is another. Getting there forced us to rethink the second-order effects too, like where durable reference state lives and how compaction and garbage collection scale.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还没有完成。 这些步骤就位后，下一个限制就是写入吞吐量。 每次写入仍然要等待各自持有完整仓库副本的副本节点，但实际上写入中只有很少的部分需要排序。 Git 对象是不可变的，并以自身内容命名，因此无需任何人达成一致就可以存储它们。 剩下的部分很小，难点在于尽可能快地对其进行排序，同时不把瓶颈转移到别处。 在白板上为此进行设计是一回事。 而在开发者与智能体全天候写入的十亿个仓库之下实现它则是另一回事。 做到这一点迫使我们重新思考二阶效应，例如持久化的引用状态存放在哪里，以及压缩与垃圾回收如何扩展。

sents.en: We’re not done yet.
sents.zh: 我们还没有完成。

sents.en: With these steps in place, the next limit is write throughput.
sents.zh: 这些步骤就位后，下一个限制就是写入吞吐量。

sents.en: Every write still waits on replicas that each hold a full copy of the repository, yet very little of a write actually needs to be ordered.
sents.zh: 每次写入仍然要等待各自持有完整仓库副本的副本节点，但实际上写入中只有很少的部分需要排序。

sents.en: Git objects are immutable and named by their contents, so they can be stored without anyone agreeing on them.
sents.zh: Git 对象是不可变的，并以自身内容命名，因此无需任何人达成一致就可以存储它们。

sents.en: What’s left is small, and the hard part is ordering it as fast as possible without moving the bottleneck somewhere else.
sents.zh: 剩下的部分很小，难点在于尽可能快地对其进行排序，同时不把瓶颈转移到别处。

sents.en: Designing for that on a whiteboard is one thing.
sents.zh: 在白板上为此进行设计是一回事。

sents.en: Doing it underneath a billion repositories that developers and agents are writing to around the clock is another.
sents.zh: 而在开发者与智能体全天候写入的十亿个仓库之下实现它则是另一回事。

sents.en: Getting there forced us to rethink the second-order effects too, like where durable reference state lives and how compaction and garbage collection scale.
sents.zh: 做到这一点迫使我们重新思考二阶效应，例如持久化的引用状态存放在哪里，以及压缩与垃圾回收如何扩展。

paragraphs.en: Agent traffic isn’t slowing down, and each of these steps gives repositories more headroom as it lands, without waiting for the end state.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体流量并未放缓，而这里的每一步在落地时都会为代码仓库留出更多余量，而无需等到最终状态。

paragraphs.en: Coming next week: At GitHub Universe and in the final post in this series, we’ll take a tour through that end state, what it does for write throughput, the second-order problems we had to solve to get there, and why there’s still a (small) consensus group somewhere in the stack.
paragraphs.zh: 下周预告：在 GitHub Universe 大会以及本系列的最后一篇文章中，我们将带您了解这一最终形态，它对写入吞吐量的作用、我们为达成这一目标而必须解决的二阶问题，以及为什么技术栈中仍然存在一个（小型的）共识组。

paragraphs.zh: 感谢 Brian Celenza 对本文的贡献。

paragraphs.en: We’re rebuilding GitHub’s Git infrastructure while GitHub keeps running, creating a foundation for agent-scale software development.
paragraphs.zh: 我们正在 GitHub 保持运行的同时重建其 Git 基础设施，为智能体规模的软件开发奠定基础。

paragraphs.en: The open source Git project just released Git 2.56. Here is GitHub’s look at some of the most interesting features and changes introduced since last time.
paragraphs.zh: 开源 Git 项目刚刚发布了 Git 2.56。 以下是 GitHub 对自上次以来引入的一些最有趣的功能和更改的介绍。

sents.en: The open source Git project just released Git 2.56.
sents.zh: 开源 Git 项目刚刚发布了 Git 2.56。

sents.en: Here is GitHub’s look at some of the most interesting features and changes introduced since last time.
sents.zh: 以下是 GitHub 对自上次以来引入的一些最有趣的功能和更改的介绍。

paragraphs.en: Put native GitHub features to work to review outside collaborator access and archive stale repositories.
paragraphs.zh: 利用 GitHub 原生功能来审查外部协作者访问权限并归档过期的仓库。

paragraphs.en: Our new repo star history API now provides trends without returning individual identities or requiring unbounded database work. These are the engineering tradeoffs we made.
paragraphs.zh: 我们新的仓库星标历史 API 现在可以在不返回个人身份信息、也不需要无界数据库操作的情况下提供趋势数据。 这些是我们所做的工程权衡。

sents.en: Our new repo star history API now provides trends without returning individual identities or requiring unbounded database work.
sents.zh: 我们新的仓库星标历史 API 现在可以在不返回个人身份信息、也不需要无界数据库操作的情况下提供趋势数据。

sents.en: These are the engineering tradeoffs we made.
sents.zh: 这些是我们所做的工程权衡。

paragraphs.en: Everything you need to master GitHub, all in one place.
paragraphs.zh: 掌握 GitHub 所需的一切，尽在此处。

paragraphs.en: Build what’s next on GitHub, the place for anyone from anywhere to build anything.
paragraphs.zh: 在 GitHub 上构建未来，这里是任何人从任何地方构建任何事物的地方。

paragraphs.en: Meet the companies and engineering teams that build with GitHub.
paragraphs.zh: 认识那些使用 GitHub 进行开发的公司和工程团队。

paragraphs.en: Join us October 28-29 in San Francisco or online for GitHub Universe, our flagship developer event uniting people, agents, and the world’s code.
paragraphs.zh: 10月28日至29日，欢迎在旧金山或线上参加 GitHub Universe——我们的旗舰开发者盛会，汇聚人、智能体与全球代码。

paragraphs.en: Discover tips, technical guides, and best practices in our biweekly newsletter just for devs.
paragraphs.zh: 在我们的双周刊简报中发现专为开发者准备的技巧、技术指南和最佳实践。
